class.name: AnimationTreeEditorPlugin
class.brief_description: Built-in central animation graph editor and storage operations.
class.description: Edits scene-owned and shared animation graphs using native graph controls. Shared files retain a skeleton association for editor context. Each AnimationTree maintains its own playback parameters.

method.name: make_graph_embedded
method.description: Creates an embedded graph copy for this node and saves its owning scene.

method.name: open_node_document
method.description: Opens the node's embedded graph or shared graph file in the central tab bar.

method.name: save_shared_graph
method.description: Saves the current graph to a text .animtree file, records its skeleton association, and binds the node to the file. Saves the owning scene.

method.name: use_shared_graph
method.description: Loads a shared graph, checks its skeleton association, and saves the new node binding in the owning scene.
